about_the_game:
Stress Ball: Confront the Stress of Jumping!

Get ready for an extraordinary journey filled with excitement and challenging obstacles! "Stress Ball" is a 3D ball game that takes you on an adventure through thrilling courses, platforms, and demanding challenges. Immerse yourself in this unique experience and explore the world through the eyes of a bouncing ball.

Main Character: A Ball!
Your main character is a ball! However, this is no ordinary ball. It's an adventurer navigating through challenging courses and platforms by bouncing towards the goal. The control is in your hands, and thrilling moments await you!



Increasingly Challenging Levels
"Stress Ball" introduces you to various levels that will take you away from the ordinary. Tasks that may seem simple at first become increasingly challenging as you progress. Overcome each level with skill and speed, unlock new courses, and conquer challenging obstacles.

Dark Theme and Atmosphere
With its depth of nuances and dark theme, "Stress Ball" invites you into a mysterious world. Enhanced graphics and atmospheric music promise players an immersive experience. Are you ready for this stressful journey into the dark?



Coming Soon on Steam!
"Stress Ball" will soon be available on Steam. Don't miss out on this unique game and discover the world through the eyes of a ball. Navigate through courses, overcome obstacles, and use your wits to reach the goal!

Follow our official social media accounts to stay informed about the official release date for Stress Ball and receive updates.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bits Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K@3.3GHz or AMD FX 6300@3.5GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 780 or AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bits Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K@3.5GHz or Ryzen 5 1500X@3.5GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Experience the blend of fun and challenge with Stress Ball! In this 3D ball game, your character bounces through platforms toward the goal. As levels intensify, and a dark theme adds depth to the atmosphere, immerse yourself in the thrill of overcoming increasingly difficult obstacles.
